description:
Compare two grayscale images you supply inside a region of interest: how many pixels
        changed, by how much, and whether that is an alarm. No camera or equipment access.
        Example: analyze_visual_change(image=[[0.5, 0.6], [0.5, 0.9]], baseline=[[0.5, 0.5], [0.5, 0.5]]).

affected_fraction_alarm.description: Fraction of changed pixels (0 to 1) that raises an alarm.
affected_fraction_alarm.title: Affected Fraction Alarm

baseline.description: The reference image, same size as image.
baseline.title: Baseline

delta_threshold.description: Change in gray level (0 to 1) that marks a pixel as changed.
delta_threshold.title: Delta Threshold

image.description: The current grayscale image you supply, rows of values from 0 to 1.
image.title: Image

quality.description: Quality of the images: good, uncertain or bad.
quality.title: Quality

roi.description: Region of interest [x, y, width, height] in pixels; omit for the whole image.
roi.title: Roi

name: analyze_visual_change
title: Analyze a visual change
